candidates.printedLatin: Sed coelum illud quod intra non est, cur non habeat sui generis terram, quemadmodum et illud quod cernitur habet terram suam?
candidates.englishAsRendered: But that heaven which is not within — why should it not have a land of its own kind, just as that heaven which is seen has its own land?
candidates.conjecture: quod intra nos est ("which is within us") — nos has dropped out and non stands in its place
candidates.whyContradiction: reverses the argument against the immediately preceding sentence, 'De regno coelorum catholica fides certissime agnovit quod intra nos sit' (the kingdom of heaven is most certainly known to be within us), and the immediately following sentence, 'Si intra nos est regnum coelorum, cur non et intra nos sit terra viventium?' (if the kingdom of heaven is within us...), both of which require the 'heaven' in question to BE within us, not to not be within us
